nodes.description: An indoor event hall or auditorium set up for a Certificate Handover Ceremony. The room features round tables with white chair covers and gold tablecloths arranged in a banquet style. A large presentation screen at the front displays the event title 'CERTIFICATE HANDOVER CEREMONY'. Additional screens and floral decorations are visible. The setting suggests a formal academic or institutional ceremony, likely related to dormitory or campus activities.
